title: Random Items 随机物品
description: Added 4 different kinds of Random Item Generator that can give you some random items. 添加了4个不同品质的随机物品生成器。
body:
# 简介语言 Description Language 此简介分为简体中文和英语两部分，简体中文简介在英语简介的下方。
This introduction consists of two parts: English and Simplified Chinese. The Simplified Chinese introduction is below the English introduction. # English ## Introduction This is a simple mod that adds craftable Random Item Generators. Each use of a Random Item Generator consumes a certain amount of experience points and grants the user a random item. Random Item Generators come in Iron, Gold, Diamond, and Netherite tiers, with quality, crafting cost, generated item quality, and experience point consumption all increasing with each tier. ## Items This mod adds the following items: - Iron Random Item Generator - Gold Random Item Generator - Diamond Random Item Generator - Netherite Random Item Generator ![Item Showcase](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3b665c7f775c425ed5aceeff2694f51d01c2093a.png) ## Crafting Recipes Crafted using a crafting table, recipes as follows: |Tier|Recipe Diagram| |----|--------------| |Iron|FRF
RCR

NRN| Where the letters represent: - F: Iron Ingot - G: Gold Ingot - D: Diamond - N: Netherite Ingot - R: Redstone Dust - C: Dispenser ![Iron Random Item Generator Crafting Interface](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b3716394c14f123bbb97564d6d9d1f7eb43e5f19.png) ![Gold Random Item Generator Crafting Interface](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7d3f256f697207c4e9e636a7380b875b4ba861ce.png) ![Diamond Random Item Generator Crafting Interface](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/829221abd63c39cdb9465e5d4c369349277e41f3.png) ![Netherite Ingot Random Item Generator Crafting Interface](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fd11ad5ee66a07b2abd3dbcef106f1c187b4438c.png) ## Mechanics Hold the use key to activate the Random Item Generator. This will consume a certain amount of experience points (not experience levels) and grant the user a random item, with a notification sent to the chat box. When experience points are insufficient, the chat box will display the required experience points and current experience points. ### Experience Points Consumed |Random Item Generator Tier|Experience Points Consumed| |---------------------------|--------------------------| |Iron|5| |Gold|10| |Diamond|20| |Netherite|30| ### Loot Tables Different tiers of Random Item Generators have the following loot tables: **Iron _5 XP/use_** | No. | Item | Quantity | Weight | |-----|------|----------|--------| | 1 | Iron Ingot | 1 | 10 | | 2 | Iron Block | 1 | 10 | | 3 | Oak Log | 2 | 10 | | 4 | Bread | 4 | 10 | | 5 | Raw Porkchop | 4 | 10 | | 6 | Cooked Porkchop | 2 | 10 | | 7 | Name Tag | 1 | 10 | | 8 | Chainmail Boots | 1 | 3 | | 9 | Chainmail Chestplate | 1 | 3 | | 10 | Chainmail Leggings | 1 | 3 | | 11 | Chainmail Helmet | 1 | 3 | | 12 | Iron Pickaxe | 1 | 3 | | 13 | Iron Block | 2 | 3 | | 14 | Emerald | 8 | 3 | | 15 | Regular Regeneration Potion | 1 | 3 | | 16 | Regular Night Vision Potion | 1 | 3 | | 17 | Regular Fire Resistance Potion | 1 | 3 | **Gold _10 XP/use_** | No. | Item | Quantity | Weight | |-----|------|----------|--------| | 1 | Gold Ingot | 1 | 10 | | 2 | Gold Block | 1 | 10 | | 3 | Golden Apple | 1 | 10 | | 4 | Golden Carrot | 4 | 10 | | 5 | Iron Block | 2 | 10 | | 6 | Ender Pearl | 1 | 10 | | 7 | Blaze Rod | 3 | 10 | | 8 | Obsidian | 8 | 10 | | 9 | Lapis Lazuli | 3 | 10 | | 10 | Enchanted Book

_Flight Duration: 1_ | 4 | 15 | Note: Probability = Item Weight ÷ Total Weight of all items in this tier Random Item Generator # 简体中文 ## 简介 这是一个简单的模组，添加了可合成的随机物品生成器。每次使用随机物品生成器时都会消耗一定点数的经验值并给予使用者一个随机的物品。 随机物品生成器有铁质、金质、钻石质、下界合金质，品质依次增加，对应的合成成本、生成的物品品质、消耗的经验值也依次增加。 ## 物品 此模组添加了以下物品： - 铁质随机物品生成器 - 金质随机物品生成器 - 钻石质随机物品生成器 - 下界合金质随机物品生成器 ![物品展示图片](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7738f589643344deecde4290945cb3c79c7b2597.png) ## 合成配方 使用工作台合成，配方如下表： |品质|配方示意图| |----|----------| |铁质|FRF
RCR

NRN| 其中字母含义如下所示： - F：铁锭 - G：金锭 - D：钻石 - N：下界合金锭 - R：红石粉 - C：发射器 ![铁质随机物品生成器合成界面](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/632a51644bfc2b4a6db04b7b0463f993ae089055.png) ![金质随机物品生成器合成界面](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5c94a88c480feeaa4d87bc6fc74787e7470fb6c6.png) ![钻石质随机物品生成器合成界面](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/29d067c02f2b57aaee553f183800a71c1b035561.png) ![下界合金质随机物品生成器合成界面](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/eaedd25573fc89007aae172e91cbf40c8c691f72.png) ## 机制 按住使用键即可使用随机物品生成器。此时会消耗一定点数的经验值（不是经验等级，是经验值），并给予使用者一个随机的物品，并在聊天框发送提示。当经验值不足时，聊天框会提示所需经验值与当前经验值。 ### 消耗的经验值 消耗的经验值如下表： |随机物品生成器品质|消耗的经验值| |------------------|------------| |铁|5| |金|10| |钻石|20| |下界合金|30| ### 战利品 不同品质的随机物品生成器的战利品如下： **铁质 _5经验/次_** | 序号 | 物品 | 数量 | 权重 | |------|------|------|------| | 1 | 铁锭 | 1 | 10 | | 2 | 铁块 | 1 | 10 | | 3 | 橡木原木 | 2 | 10 | | 4 | 面包 | 4 | 10 | | 5 | 生猪排 | 4 | 10 | | 6 | 熟猪排 | 2 | 10 | | 7 | 命名牌 | 1 | 10 | | 8 | 锁链靴子 | 1 | 3 | | 9 | 锁链胸甲 | 1 | 3 | | 10 | 锁链护腿 | 1 | 3 | | 11 | 锁链头盔 | 1 | 3 | | 12 | 铁镐 | 1 | 3 | | 13 | 铁块 | 2 | 3 | | 14 | 绿宝石 | 8 | 3 | | 15 | 普通版再生药水 | 1 | 3 | | 16 | 普通版夜视药水 | 1 | 3 | | 17 | 普通版抗火药水 | 1 | 3 | **金质 _10经验/次_** | 序号 | 物品 | 数量 | 权重 | |------|------|------|------| | 1 | 金锭 | 1 | 10 | | 2 | 金块 | 1 | 10 | | 3 | 金苹果 | 1 | 10 | | 4 | 金胡萝卜 | 4 | 10 | | 5 | 铁块 | 2 | 10 | | 6 | 末影珍珠 | 1 | 10 | | 7 | 烈焰棒 | 3 | 10 | | 8 | 黑曜石 | 8 | 10 | | 9 | 青金石 | 3 | 10 | | 10 | 附魔书
